note: Facade kit data (Vela). Every colour the facade, shopfront and roof code uses lives here (hex, sRGB), baked into one 16x16 swatch atlas. The values once kept dE2000 20 from the signals (cones #e03a2f, guard #f0a020, rivals #8a4fd0; out/palette/facade-safety.ts); Sky dropped the signal-colour reservation on 2026-10-16: signals stay readable by drawing unlit and emissive with their own shape or motion cue, so red, amber and violet are free for the world, and that check no longer gates anything. Glass was clear (grammar §3: no blue curtain-wall tint) until brief 072-G: glass_clear = the kit window (DK_Window_Teal), glass_t = clear acrylic (DK_Glass) read opaque, glass_dark = shop doors (Latch, 007 round 2; signed off by Vela, round 3). Round 3 (Sky: too much beige): the enamel sets are saturated faience (teal #36b0a8, coral #fc9c84, brass gold #d0c848, mint #7fd0b8, peach #fcc4ac), every area carries teal and gold, and each family's plinth swatch (_p: plinth, ground-storey band, shop bulkhead base) is a faience accent, not a darker stone (grammar §2a). Geometry: bay and storey heights copy plan standards.buildings (bay 6, plinth 0.45, groundStorey 5.2, upperStorey 3.6); ground = plinth + groundStorey + the 0.18 pavement datum. Brief 008 (Sky, 2026-10-14): brass, not gold, at street level and on facades: gold, sand_p and the sign boards' gold_trim are brass #99784d, t_hotel #ad866f, ivory_p #d8cdb8, e_sun sunshine enamel #f8e26c; skyline crowns keep their gold in the kit (DK_Crown_Gold*). Area enamel pairs paint roof items (spheres, boxes, signs, awnings), tower walls, fins and bands, so `gold` left the lantern and records pairs for e_sun (coordinator's ruling, 2026-10-14: brass is hairline, frame and bead only); `gold` stays on the jazz-club and pawnbroker trade edges. Brief 072-G (Sky, 2026-10-27, on the 072-B proposal: "yep, more, more reds / blues allowed as well"; the Office's deep teal band "yep"; the powder-blue road kept): walls warmer and a little deeper (cream_w #EBDABA, peach_w #F2C4A4 ...); brass-gold #C29A55 for gold, civic_trim and gold_trim (t_hotel #C9A46A); glass is dark teal to blue-teal with sky reflections (glass_clear #2C6478, glass_dark #233F50), still no curtain-wall towers in the play streets; DecoKit's enamels pickable (e_mustard, e_coral_deep, e_royal, e_teal_deep) and the push's reds and blues (e_red #C42A1F, e_redorange #E8553A, e_oxblood #8E2F25, e_powder #86ADD3) in every area's enamel set; plinths peach_p red-orange coral, sky_p royal, sand_p oxblood (not brass: a plinth band is a large surface); two new families, blush (pale coral stone, enamel-red plinth) and powder (powder-blue render, royal plinth); trades diner, record shop, cinema, travel bureau and garage in reds and blues; civic enamel seafoam + deep teal (C1). Matte 0.22, glossy 0.72 (a soft sheen). Values: briefs/072/style/rules.json `applied`. Brief 072, second push (Sky, 2026-10-28: "yeah, I more colors needed"): four new wall families, butter (#f7e38c, cerulean plinth), lilac (#d8c8ec, plum plinth), apricot (#f9b977, jade plinth) and seagreen (#9ad2c6, tangerine plinth); sand_w deeper (#ddbe8a), blush_w pinker (#f4c3c8), sky_w a clear sky blue (#9ccdee), mint_w greener (#c8e8c6) with a rose plinth (#d9548a), so neighbouring walls sit at least about 9 dE2000 apart (cream and ivory excepted); family roofs one tint deeper; cream's weight 4 -> 2; new enamels e_tangerine, e_plum, e_cerulean, e_jade, e_lime in the areas' sets (civic keeps seafoam + deep teal); trades launderette cerulean, radio-tv tangerine, chandler jade. Values: briefs/072/style/rules.json `applied2`. Brief 075 old palette (Sky 2026-10-29: "our red is too red ... it needs to go back to old town"; Vela): the families are the old town's own, the old DecoKitColourways scheme (plan+livery+soft): the five ensembles boulevard, circus, harbour, gardens, southside and the high street's Soft palette soft-apricot, soft-celadon, soft-rose, soft-ochre (tools/decokit/colourways.py, which paints the kit pieces the same). Per family: _w the wall (boulevard: the kit's limestone, the old facade_panel_v1 sheet's mean #e6d7c1), _p the fascia (the old ensemble's strong horizontal: the procedural plinth / ground-storey band), _s the sill bands (the kit's seafoam #72b5a7 where the old ensemble kept it), _r the roof at the old Lighter (halfway in linear to ivory #efe8d6). Each area draws its old ensemble (records, lamplight: boulevard; lantern: southside; docks, harbour: harbour; crescent: circus; gardens: gardens) and its enamel pair is that ensemble's fascia and sills. The 12 families of 072/074, the old* additions, 072-G's glass and trade colours and the civic wall go back to the values before 072-G (glass_clear #2e6d70 = the kit window DK_Window_Teal). Was: out/scratch/vela/palette/before/facade.json and git history.
